quests.title: The mill
quests.text: Crush, grind and leach uranium ore with sulfuric acid; solvent extraction (on kerosene from the crude unit) and precipitation, then a dryer on pipeline gas, fill drums of yellowcake.

quests.title: Conversion to UF6
quests.text: Reduce, hydrofluorinate and fluorinate the yellowcake; cold traps and distillation fill 48Y cylinders of UF6.

quests.title: Enrichment
quests.text: A centrifuge cascade on its frequency converter takes natural UF6 to 4.95 % in 30B cylinders.

quests.title: Fuel assemblies
quests.text: Turn UF6 to powder, press and sinter pellets, load and weld rods, and build 17x17 assemblies. The core takes nine. With fuelNickelHardware on, the hardware takes 304 stainless and nickel-chromium alloy from the alloy melt shop (induction furnace and AOD converter) and the nickel refinery.

quests.title: Control rods
quests.text: Boron carbide pellets in rodlets on a spider: the RCCA bench builds the control rods the reactor moves. The reactor holds at LOADING until five are in.
